checkpoints.v1.AssetAmount.description: AssetAmount is a total of one asset.

amount.description:
Amount in whole asset units, encoded as a base-10 decimal string without
 separators.
amount.title: amount

excludedFromValue.description:
True when the asset does not count toward account value, for example a
 test token that cannot be traded. It is listed by amount only, has no
 USD value and is left out of every USD total, which it never makes
 approximate or omitted.
excludedFromValue.title: excluded_from_value

usd.description:
USD value, encoded as a base-10 decimal string without separators or a
 currency symbol. Omitted when the asset had no USD price at the required
 time, and always when excluded_from_value is true.
usd.title: usd

checkpoints.v1.AssetAmount.title: AssetAmount

checkpoints.v1.BiggestTrade.description: BiggestTrade identifies the season's largest trade fill by USD value.

side.description: The account's side of the fill.
side.title: side

symbol.description:
Display symbol of the market, for example BTC-USDT. Empty when the market
 is no longer listed.
symbol.title: symbol

checkpoints.v1.BiggestTrade.title: BiggestTrade

checkpoints.v1.ChainFlow.description: ChainFlow is the deposits or withdrawals on one Polyester Chain.

chainName.description:
Display name of the chain, for example Ethereum Sepolia. Empty when the
 chain is not in the current chain catalog.
chainName.title: chain_name

total.description: Number of operations and their USD total on this chain.
total.title: total

checkpoints.v1.ChainFlow.title: ChainFlow

checkpoints.v1.Checkpoint.description:
Checkpoint is one frozen season recap of a root account and all of its
 subaccounts. Only the account owner can read it.

badges.description: Badges earned in the season, in badge display order.
badges.title: badges

biggestTrade.description:
The fill valued biggest_trade_usd, the earliest on a tie. Omitted when no
 fill could be valued.
biggestTrade.title: biggest_trade

biggestTradeUsd.description:
Largest single trade fill in USD, encoded as a non-negative base-10
 decimal string without separators or a currency symbol.
biggestTradeUsd.title: biggest_trade_usd

busiestDay.description:
UTC date with the most trade fills, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD. Omitted
 without trades.
busiestDay.title: busiest_day

cancelRatio.description:
Share of placed orders that ended canceled, a base-10 decimal string from
 0 to 1.
cancelRatio.title: cancel_ratio

dailyClaimAmounts.description:
Daily claim totals per asset, by asset ascending, each valued in USD
 when it was paid. Assets excluded from value are listed by amount only.
dailyClaimAmounts.title: daily_claim_amounts

dailyVolume.description:
Volume and trade fills of every UTC day of the season, oldest first, days
 without trades included.
dailyVolume.title: daily_volume

daysActive.description: Number of UTC days with at least one trade.
daysActive.title: days_active

fillRate.description:
Share of placed orders that ended fully filled, a base-10 decimal string
 from 0 to 1.
fillRate.title: fill_rate

finalValueUsd.description:
USD value of all trading and funding balances at the end of the season
 that count toward account value, encoded as a base-10 decimal string.
 Assets excluded from value add nothing. Omitted when any other balance
 had no USD value.
finalValueUsd.title: final_value_usd

firstTradeAt.description: UTC time of the first trade fill in the season. Omitted without trades.
firstTradeAt.title: first_trade_at

fundingBalances.description:
Funding balance per asset at the end of the season, valued in USD at that
 time; assets excluded from value are listed by amount only. Shown for
 the record only.
fundingBalances.title: funding_balances

fundingByDay.description:
Deposit and withdrawal USD values per UTC day with at least one of them,
 oldest first.
fundingByDay.title: funding_by_day

incomplete.description:
Values computed from partial evidence, in ascending enum order. Empty
 when every value is exact.
incomplete.title: incomplete

inflowUsd.description:
USD value brought in during the season: daily claim payouts, deposits
 and transfers in, each valued when it happened, over assets that count
 toward account value; assets excluded from value add nothing. Encoded as
 a non-negative base-10 decimal string without separators or a currency
 symbol. Omitted when any other part had no USD value.
inflowUsd.title: inflow_usd

longestStreak.description: Longest run of consecutive UTC days with at least one trade.
longestStreak.title: longest_streak

makerTrades.description: Trade fills on the maker side.
makerTrades.title: maker_trades

medianLimitRestMs.description:
Typical time a good-till-canceled or good-till-date limit order rested
 before it filled or was canceled, in milliseconds. Omitted when no such
 order ended in the season.
medianLimitRestMs.title: median_limit_rest_ms

mostActiveHourUtc.description:
UTC hour of day, 0 through 23, with the most trade fills. Omitted without
 trades.
mostActiveHourUtc.title: most_active_hour_utc

netInflowUsd.description:
inflow_usd minus outflow_usd, encoded as a base-10 decimal string that
 may be negative. Omitted when either is omitted.
netInflowUsd.title: net_inflow_usd

number.description:
Positive checkpoint number. Checkpoint 1 is the first season; numbers
 increase by season.
number.title: number

openingValueUsd.description:
USD value of the funding balances restored to the account when the
 season opened, valued at the end of the season like final_value_usd,
 over assets that count toward account value; assets excluded from value
 add nothing. Encoded as a non-negative base-10 decimal string without
 separators or a currency symbol; "0" when the season opened with no
 balances. Omitted when a restored balance had no USD value.
openingValueUsd.title: opening_value_usd

outflowUsd.description:
USD value taken out during the season: withdrawals and transfers out,
 each valued when it happened, over assets that count toward account
 value; assets excluded from value add nothing. Encoded as a non-negative
 base-10 decimal string without separators or a currency symbol. Omitted
 when any other part had no USD value.
outflowUsd.title: outflow_usd

partiallyFilledOrders.description: Orders that ended canceled or rejected after a partial fill.
partiallyFilledOrders.title: partially_filled_orders

peakVipTier.description: Highest VIP tier reached during the season, 0 through 10.
peakVipTier.title: peak_vip_tier

portfolioValue.description:
Portfolio value at the end of each hour, oldest first. Hours without a
 recorded value are absent; draw them as gaps, not zero.
portfolioValue.title: portfolio_value

seasonEnd.description: UTC end of the season, exclusive.
seasonEnd.title: season_end

seasonResultUsd.description:
Season result: final_value_usd minus opening_value_usd minus
 net_inflow_usd, encoded as a base-10 decimal string that may be negative.
 Price moves on restored holdings are not counted as result. Omitted when
 any of them is omitted.
seasonResultUsd.title: season_result_usd

seasonStart.description: UTC start of the season, inclusive.
seasonStart.title: season_start

selfTrades.description: Trade fills where both sides belonged to this account.
selfTrades.title: self_trades

takenAt.description: UTC time at which the checkpoint was recorded.
takenAt.title: taken_at

takerTrades.description: Trade fills on the taker side.
takerTrades.title: taker_trades

timeInForce.description: Placed orders by time in force.
timeInForce.title: time_in_force

topPairs.description:
Markets traded, highest volume first, then by symbol_id ascending. This
 is naturally bounded by the number of markets traded and is not
 paginated.
topPairs.title: top_pairs

tradesByWeekdayHour.description: Trade fills by UTC weekday and hour: exactly 7 entries, Monday first.
tradesByWeekdayHour.title: trades_by_weekday_hour

tradingBalances.description:
Trading balance per asset at the end of the season, valued in USD at that
 time; assets excluded from value are listed by amount only. Shown for
 the record only.
tradingBalances.title: trading_balances

transfersIn.description: Transfers received from other accounts, excluding daily claim payouts.
transfersIn.title: transfers_in

vipTierAtCheckpoint.description: VIP tier at the moment the checkpoint was recorded, 0 through 10.
vipTierAtCheckpoint.title: vip_tier_at_checkpoint

vipTimeline.description:
VIP tier changes during the season, oldest first. The first entry is the
 tier at the season start when one was in effect.
vipTimeline.title: vip_timeline

volumeUsd.description:
Season trading volume in USD, encoded as a non-negative base-10 decimal
 string without separators or a currency symbol.
volumeUsd.title: volume_usd

checkpoints.v1.Checkpoint.title: Checkpoint

checkpoints.v1.CheckpointBadge.description:
CheckpointBadge is an achievement earned in one season by meeting a fixed
 threshold. Badges never depend on other accounts' activity. Values are in
 display order.
checkpoints.v1.CheckpointBadge.title: CheckpointBadge

checkpoints.v1.CheckpointField.description:
CheckpointField names a checkpoint value computed from partial evidence,
 for example trades or holdings that had no USD price at the required time.
 The value shown is a lower bound or omitted; show it with an approximation
 marker rather than hiding the field.
checkpoints.v1.CheckpointField.title: CheckpointField

checkpoints.v1.EarnedBadge.description: EarnedBadge is a badge and when it was earned.

earnedAt.description: UTC time the badge's threshold was first crossed, within the season.
earnedAt.title: earned_at

checkpoints.v1.EarnedBadge.title: EarnedBadge

checkpoints.v1.FlowTotal.description:
FlowTotal counts operations and sums their USD values, each valued when it
 happened.

count.description:
Number of operations, including operations in assets excluded from
 value.
count.title: count

usd.description:
USD total over assets that count toward account value, encoded as a
 non-negative base-10 decimal string without separators or a currency
 symbol. Assets excluded from value add nothing. Omitted when any other
 operation had no USD value.
usd.title: usd

checkpoints.v1.FlowTotal.title: FlowTotal

checkpoints.v1.FundingDay.description:
FundingDay is the deposit and withdrawal value of one UTC day, over assets
 that count toward account value; assets excluded from value add nothing.

depositUsd.description:
USD value of the day's deposits, encoded as a non-negative base-10
 decimal string without separators or a currency symbol; "0" without a
 deposit. Omitted when a deposit had no USD value.
depositUsd.title: deposit_usd

withdrawalUsd.description:
USD value of the day's withdrawals, encoded as a non-negative base-10
 decimal string without separators or a currency symbol; "0" without a
 withdrawal. Omitted when a withdrawal had no USD value.
withdrawalUsd.title: withdrawal_usd

checkpoints.v1.FundingDay.title: FundingDay

checkpoints.v1.FundingFlowSummary.description: FundingFlowSummary summarizes successful deposits or withdrawals.

amounts.description:
Totals per asset, by asset ascending, each valued in USD when it was
 made. Assets excluded from value are listed by amount only.
amounts.title: amounts

chains.description:
Operations per chain, by polyester_chain_id ascending. Operations without
 a known chain are counted only in count.
chains.title: chains

checkpoints.v1.FundingFlowSummary.title: FundingFlowSummary

checkpoints.description:
Checkpoints of the root account, newest first. There is at most one per
 season, so the list is naturally bounded and not paginated. Empty when
 the account has no checkpoint, for example when it did not trade in any
 recorded season.
checkpoints.title: checkpoints

checkpoints.v1.OrderToolCounts.description:
OrderToolCounts counts distinct uses of each order tool. One strategy that
 generates several orders counts once.
checkpoints.v1.OrderToolCounts.title: OrderToolCounts

checkpoints.v1.OrderTypeCounts.description: OrderTypeCounts counts placed orders by order type.
checkpoints.v1.OrderTypeCounts.title: OrderTypeCounts

checkpoints.v1.PairActivity.description: PairActivity is the season activity on one spot market.

symbol.description:
Display symbol of the market, for example BTC-USDT. Empty when the market
 is no longer listed.
symbol.title: symbol

trades.description: Number of trade fills on this market.
trades.title: trades

volumeUsd.description:
Season trading volume on this market in USD, encoded as a non-negative
 base-10 decimal string without separators or a currency symbol.
volumeUsd.title: volume_usd

checkpoints.v1.PairActivity.title: PairActivity

checkpoints.v1.PortfolioValuePoint.description: PortfolioValuePoint is the account's portfolio value at the end of one hour.

approximate.description:
True when this value is approximate because some holdings could not be
 valued at that hour.
approximate.title: approximate

usd.description:
Portfolio value in USD, encoded as a base-10 decimal string without
 separators or a currency symbol.
usd.title: usd

checkpoints.v1.PortfolioValuePoint.title: PortfolioValuePoint

checkpoints.v1.TimeInForceCounts.description: TimeInForceCounts counts placed orders by time in force.
checkpoints.v1.TimeInForceCounts.title: TimeInForceCounts

checkpoints.v1.VIPTierChange.description: VIPTierChange is a VIP tier in effect from one UTC date of the season.

date.description: UTC date from which the tier applies, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD.
date.title: date

tier.description: VIP tier in the inclusive range 0 through 10.
tier.title: tier

checkpoints.v1.VIPTierChange.title: VIPTierChange

checkpoints.v1.VolumePoint.description: VolumePoint is the trading activity of one UTC day.

approximate.description:
True when the day's volume is a lower bound because some of its trades
 could not be valued.
approximate.title: approximate

day.description: UTC midnight that starts the day.
day.title: day

trades.description:
Number of trade fills on the day, including fills against the account's
 own orders, which add no volume.
trades.title: trades

usd.description:
Settled trading volume of the day in USD, encoded as a non-negative
 base-10 decimal string without separators or a currency symbol.
usd.title: usd

checkpoints.v1.VolumePoint.title: VolumePoint

checkpoints.v1.WeekdayTrades.description: WeekdayTrades counts trade fills on one UTC weekday by UTC hour.

hours.description: Exactly 24 counts, one per UTC hour of the day from 0 through 23.
hours.title: hours

checkpoints.v1.WeekdayTrades.title: WeekdayTrades

orders.v1.Side.description: Side identifies whether an order buys or sells the base asset.
orders.v1.Side.title: Side

BrokerApiKeyAuth.description: Broker API key, sent as a bearer token and accepted only by the QuickSwap broker API. The broker API key is a server credential. Call this API from the broker's backend, never from a browser or mobile app. The broker's members create, rotate and revoke keys through the QuickSwap broker API, and a key may rotate itself.

info.description:
Public trading API for market makers and integrators.
Connect RPC over HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 with JSON and Protobuf.
info.title: Polyester API

get.description: List every checkpoint of the authenticated caller's root account, newest first. Checkpoints are private to the account owner.

parameters.description:
Optional subaccount public identifier. Checkpoints cover a root account
 and all of its subaccounts, so a subaccount resolves to its root account,
 which must be the caller's own.

Public ID, as a base58 string.
parameters.name: subaccountId

schema.description:
Optional subaccount public identifier. Checkpoints cover a root account
 and all of its subaccounts, so a subaccount resolves to its root account,
 which must be the caller's own.
schema.title: subaccount_id
